question: One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 67 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 66 km/hr, and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 17 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place) for the entire journey is:
solution:
**Given:**

First 1/3 distance speed = 67 km/hr

Second 1/3 distance speed = 66 km/hr

Last 1/3 distance speed = 17 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

Let total distance = 3 km ⇒ each part = 1 km

⇒ Time for 1st part = 1 ÷ 67 hr

⇒ Time for 2nd part = 1 ÷ 66 hr

⇒ Time for 3rd part = 1 ÷ 17 hr

⇒ LCM of 67, 66, 17 = 75174

⇒ Total time = (75174 ÷ 67 + 75174 ÷ 66 + 75174 ÷ 17) ÷ 75174

⇒ Total time = (1122 + 1139 + 4422) ÷ 75174 = 6683 ÷ 75174 hr

Average speed = 3 ÷ (6683 ÷ 75174)

⇒ Average speed = (3 × 75174) ÷ 6683 = 225522 ÷ 6683

⇒ Average speed ≈ 33.7 km/hr (rounded to 1 decimal place)

**∴ Average speed ≈ 33.7 km/hr.**
